A roof on low ground shades a worker while the high-water mark still places that room below flood level.
reject: An open desert with a blue puddle and an invisible safe-cell marker is labelled a canyon.
Green ground spreads across exposed flats, or a roof is described as incapable of blocking Direct Sun, or local rain supplies the flood.

accept: A shaded natural sand bed gains deposited ordinary soil at retreat; native wet growth supports gathering, and after drying the extra fertility ends while that deposited soil persists in continuing shade.
A sun-exposed flooded flat returns to dry substrate, and a player floor or dug channel retains its identity through the wet interval.
Another flood over the same shaded bed refreshes ordinary soil without enriching it further or spreading it into unwetted neighbours; exposed natural bed returns to dry mineral ground in either tier.
reject: Receding water permanently paints rich soil over exposed flats or a constructed floor.
The ground is labelled fertile but neither native growth nor gathering changes during the wet interval.
The shaded sand bed returns only to its original sand at drying, so no flood-deposited ordinary soil exists, or stale flood wetness persists after its source ends.

meant.intent: Land supports ordinary gathering/predation/taming roles, and wet plant/animal activity belongs to the same flood rather than permanent crowding or silent disappearance. Flight is conditional on effective roster presence; a new free-tier flier is deferred, not implied.

figurative.stands_for: the same living wild pawn enters readable dry dormancy with a pan-like presentation; no disappearance or geological terrain replacement

accept: The dry map has shade plants, tarruq calls and crag life; wetted clay supports opening qirra, visibly swelling plants and moving irqit, and surviving wild sleepers become inspectable sealed pans again when dry.

The free roster supplies ordinary dry life and wet response with no flier species, no walking fictional flier and no resident flier nest.

Wet life is only a spawn counter, plants stay visually static, or irqit remain a year-round multiplying colony.
Dry sealing deletes a muttavaq, or all irqit vanish instead of dying, or a wet pan sleeps indefinitely.
Flying feeders establish resident nests on the canyon floor rather than using the canyon as feeding country.

accept: A full canyon supports ordinary dry work, interrupts it with chimes and water, then supports a brief busy wet interval before dry routines return; after a mid-cycle reload and a changed order of recall, gathering and channel work the same causes still hold.

A visiting crew can leave during a quiet stay, while a settled colony through the complete cycle sees bounded wet life, preserved work and another quiet interval without a permanent rich-soil windfall.
reject: The season is accepted with growth or damage off, weather locked clear, a manually forced patch flood or a kept feature still locked.
Water and growing things take over the upper banks, the wet return supplies no useful native activity, the map stays rich forever, or the phase clock stalls.
Reload repeats warnings or hatches, silently loses pawns, overwrites channel work or begins a continuing error storm.

rules.rule: Delegated construction rule: Local map producer saves a main reach with entry/outlet, ordered complete cross sections, banks, access and matching marks; no raw random footprint cap, planet worker or world painting. Geometry contract in definition.md.

Delegated construction rule: Front wets complete successive sections; roofs/floors/doors do not promote bed cells to high ground. Keep constructed surfaces and FlowWorks ownership; no pressure or building-destruction engine.

Delegated construction rule: Direct Sun uses the shared tile geometry; roofs/parasols cover at all angles. Veqma retains its def-wide glow law plus geometric shade; no neighbour-count substitution or biome heat fields.

Delegated construction rule: Refuge is genuinely high cliff-bank space with legal access; capacity may include upper bank outside pockets. Mobile neutral human visitors and trained player animals seek/hold/release; colonists remain ordered by player.

Delegated construction rule: Clock is dry->warning->front/standing->retreat->wet->dry. Existing ordinal save bytes may be migrated but not silently reinterpreted. Peakstorm bias is probabilistic and may not advance an already announced wall. Herald extras off; chimes and roar remain.

Delegated construction rule: Impact occurs on grounded front/late-entry contact, continued immersion risks drowning; no blanket downed/low-health safety or deterministic casualty. Nonbreathers and real airborne creatures use shared trait/flight truth; record cause and corpse identity.

Delegated construction rule: Wet fertility is a temporary benefit ending at local drying, separate from ordinary-soil deposition under R7a. Per-cell flood wet-until extends only on actual rewet; independent water is separate. No rich-soil or soak fallback on floors/engine-owned cells.

Delegated construction rule: At recede deposit ordinary Soil on actually wetted natural recorded-bed cells still flood-owned and geometrically shaded by the shared Direct Sun reader, regardless of original Sand/Soil. No floor, bridge, ore, solid rock or engine-owned excavation is eligible; weather/glow is not geometric shade. Keep ordinary Soil after wet fertility expires while shade remains; shade loss returns dry flood-owned deposits to recorded mineral baseline at the next terrain update (wet cells wait for expiry), and shade regained after sediment removal does not recreate it without another wetting/recede. Current baseline is Sand for natural Sand/Soil/SoilRich in either tier, including campaign Op 5 pure Sand; outside managed bed is untouched. Repeated floods never upgrade Soil or spread it to neighbours; new extent requires newly wetted shaded eligible bed cells. Persist baseline, deposition provenance and ownership separately from the temporary layer; player edits win.

Delegated construction rule: FlowWorks owns D/F/liquid identity and outcome decisions. Recede restores only still-owned driver changes; compare ownership/version so new pumps, fills, floor or excavation edits are not undone. Expiry/ownership records persist across reload.

Delegated construction rule: Bounded irqit cohorts follow nursery wet intervals including carry/export and leave corpses; qirra follows cell wetness; wild pan sleepers wake on wetting and seal only dry with existing ownership/downed/drafted guards. Growth terminals remain engine-owned and effective.

Delegated construction rule: Reload/disable is a transition: preserve event ownership/identities/deadlines, release refuge jobs, stop roar/damage, recede safely, finish readable living lifecycles; re-enable never collapses overdue warning. No entity silently vanishes.

Delegated construction rule: No roster evictions. Preserve memberships across tier fixes and ordinary Wreckage/Bones consumers; special behaviours get independent default-off next-version gates. External campaign owns quest, discovery locks and templates; no secret unlock to pass the whole.

Delegated construction rule: Timings, densities, yields and detailed stats are regression checks. All retained defaults effective together; normal tick acceleration preserves all relative clocks; no dev supplier, weather lock, terminal freeze or missing-feature stub can award a bar.

meetings.why: Wall-to-wall reach, genuinely high capacity, useful paths and bank siting could conflict at bends/narrow exits or with a large colony. A flag/capped BFS cannot settle their joint geometry. The same saved bed bounds all soil deposition under R7a; shade is not elevation or permission to expand sediment outside that reach.

The existing neighbour-count glow proxy and actual directional wall/roof shade can disagree. Wet fertility, visible green and living plants must use a compatible geometric set without changing Direct Sun. Deposition must use that same geometric mask, not original terrain or weather darkness; shade loss/regain and repeated footprint cannot create extra sediment.
meetings.model: M4: Shade and plant eligibility sweep

meetings.why: The default manifest is explicit: all kept features effective, optional dramaturgy/rewards off, imported dependencies attributed, no dev supplier. On/off controls are separate preference cases and never evidence for default danger. No pair requires an extra to be on; T1–T29 enforce decoupling.

Peakstorm schedule, advancing earliest contact, actual audio lead, loaded work and crowd paths must leave enough time for people while keeping freight risky; settings cannot be accepted from old numbers.
Grounded danger, true flight, later entry, downed rescue, sleeper wake and readable cohort death touch the same pawn states. No complete adapter or contact-transition enumeration exists.
Wet hatches, corpses/Bones, predator food, sleeper wake and crowd evacuation can be individually bounded yet cumulatively swamp food supply, paths or tick work.
meetings.model: M3: Whole canyon season and resource budget

meetings.why: Front/recede, temporary fertility, accepted soak, qirra, cohort expiry and terminal growth may form a long wet/permanent fertile or population feedback loop under repeated water. Include ordinary-soil deposition separately from temporary fertility and repeated-flood area bounds; original Sand snapshots cannot erase the habitat.
meetings.model: M3: Whole canyon season and resource budget

meetings.why: The rules assign one writer per ownership class: FlowWorks for excavation, player edits for changed surfaces, temporary canyon layer only for natural ground. A complete water hazard mask need not overwrite a floor. Thus danger, wet benefit and work preservation have compatible definitions; runtime compliance still needs T24/T26. Ordinary Soil deposition is the explicit natural-bed outcome under R7a, tracked separately from the temporary wet layer; generated free-tier soil is not a licence to enrich exposed bed. Floors and engine cells remain outside both writes.

Repeated wetting, disable/re-enable, transported short-lived animals and saved terrain ownership may duplicate events or resurrect old water. Scribing a list is not evidence of correct transition/relink behaviour. Save mineral baseline and deposited-soil provenance as well as wet expiry, or loading may restore Sand or duplicate fertility.

Independent engines consume documented cell/identity state; disabling canyon reward spawners does not require disabling ordinary wreck deconstruction, butchery or external arm service. The deferred campaign Swale lock is not a kept mechanic secretly unlocked by the whole scene. Test only supported supplied interfaces.
